initial.basis: Original campaign actual RUNS stage times and RESULT elapsed_seconds; no followup outcomes used.
initial.extension_formula: mean(search_seconds/training_cap)*10 + mean(refit_seconds/selected_epoch)*10 + mean(evaluation_seconds) + mean(non-stage elapsed overhead); conservatively assumes refit at epoch 10
initial.interpretation: Planner's ~11.3h arithmetic uses older K_tau profile for extension and omits per-job non-stage overhead. Actual first-campaign measured profile is used for admission. Extension is decided only after A4 and requires all 10 seeds to fit the remaining wall-clock/deadline window.
initial.all10_admission_rule: No partial seed selection. If all 10 are not expected to finish, all ten are NOT_RUN_BUDGET.
